matching_pages_notes: Original PDF pages 171-180 were rendered at 180 dpi and all 460 printed rows were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed name and initials, rank, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. All ten pages matched the extraction and no correction was needed. The review preserves repeated or near-matching rows rather than merging them: two Edward J Glavin rows, two William H Glazier rows, two Kermit Gordon rows, and two Robert H Green rows remain distinct source records. It also preserves the indexed spellings and typographical forms Eliizabeth Goodson, Thoams L Gordon, iLeon Gorski, Charlse H Gotschall, Rooco T Grasso, MIllard L Gray, and Mary Catherin Green; the suffix placements in Golden, Jr., Grau, Jr., Graves, Jr., and Green, Jr.; the printed Caf-2 and Tec. Rep grades; the French, Corsican, British, USNR, and also AS notes; and the out-of-sequence box values on pages 172 and 180. Private identifiers are not included in this bundle or public assets.
